COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_CURRENT_NODE_TOOLTIP: Show tooltip on current map node
Show the room-history tooltip when hovering over the map node you are currently on, instead of only on previously visited nodes.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_WELL_LAID_PLANS_RETA: Show retain slots for Well Laid Plans
When choosing cards to Retain with Well Laid Plans, show one dotted card outline per retain slot so it is obvious how many cards can still be picked. Selected cards fill the slots left to right.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_INTRO_LOGO.title: Skip intro Mega Crit logo
COLINSPATCHKIT-SKIP_INTRO_LOGO.hover.des: Skip the Mega Crit logo animation at startup and go straight to the main menu.
COLINSPATCHKIT-MAKE_ETHEREAL_CARDS_TRANS: Render the colored frame of Ethereal cards slightly transparent so they are easy to spot at a glance. Card text, art and icons stay fully opaque.
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.t: Pulse relics while their effect is ready
COLINSPATCHKIT-SHOW_RELIC_READY_PULSES.h: Some relics with once-per-turn or once-per-combat effects give no hint whether the effect is still available. Show the same pulsing glow used by relics like Vambrace while the effect is ready. Applies to Permafrost, Centennial Puzzle, Ruined Helmet, Lava Lamp, Demon Tongue, Mini Regent and Music Box.
